description:
What is this hotel chain's pet policy: how many pets, weight limit, fee, exceptions?
Answers chain-wide questions such as "What is Motel 6's pet policy?" or "Does Kimpton charge a pet fee?"; it does not work out one hotel's fee for a stay or say whether that hotel confirmed the chain policy.
Brands covered: Best Western (best-western), Extended Stay America (extended-stay-america), Kimpton Hotels (kimpton), La Quinta by Wyndham (la-quinta), Motel 6 (motel-6), Red Roof Inn (red-roof). Input: brand id or name, e.g. "red-roof" or "Kimpton". Any other chain is not covered.
Returns the published policy with the source URL, quote and verified date, and how many California and Nevada properties carry it.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: dogpolicies_get_brand_policy

accepted.description: With bad_input: each argument that could not be read, with the values it accepts

code.description: With an outcome other than ok: not_found, invalid, unavailable

did_you_mean.description: Close matches to what was asked for: towns, places, slugs or brands, best first

nearest.description: When nothing is inside the radius: the nearest places in the data, with distance_miles

next.description: Calls that would answer the question, in words

not_stated.description: Expected facts the sources do not state

outcome.description: Absent or ok: a normal answer. no_match: nothing in the data matches, see did_you_mean, nearest and next. bad_input: the arguments cannot be used as given, see next. partial: some of the ids were found, see missing. unavailable: a live source could not be read. None of these is an error.

resolved_from.description: Set when the name given was not exact and this brand was the one clear match

title: Get hotel brand pet policy
